Voidarch Studio daemon is not running

The desktop shell could not find or start the local Studio repository. Studio is currently distributed as an active-development source build.

  1. Clone the repository and install its dependencies.
  2. Set VOIDARCH_STUDIO_ROOT to the clone path, or launch the app from inside the clone.
  3. Start the daemon manually when needed.
pnpm install
pnpm dfc:dashboard --repo-root /path/to/your/repository

# optional for the desktop shell
export VOIDARCH_STUDIO_ROOT=/path/to/voidarch

The shell will connect automatically when the daemon answers on 127.0.0.1:4949.
